answer: Speed-of-light co-presence attestation: verifier sends nonces via distributed saffron beacons; an agent’s reply must arrive inside a location-specific light-cone window, checked by a kernel that tolerates network wander. Each identity is bound to a hardware transceiver at a verified site. A single operator cannot fake many distant identities without placing and powering separate transceivers within each light cone; spoofing requires physical sites, synchronized clocks, and low-latency links, making each Sybil cost hardware plus real estate and maintenance.
